arguments.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.Score > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
) AS percentage_above_50
FROM main.posts AS p
JOIN main.users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM main.users)
LIMIT 1
